mentions.name: Wrote Myself a Letter
mentions.description: This app lets users write and send a letter to their future self, which the author finds therapeutic. It works fully offline with no tracking, ads, or subscriptions, and is sold as a one-time purchase that users own forever.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been working on the latest update to my app: Wrote Myself a Letter which I finished after being laid off.
The idea is to send a letter to your future self, which I personally find very therapeutic in many ways, but what is important is the app is fully offline, has 0 tracking, ads or subscriptions. It's a once off purchase and own forever
